purpose: Live classification contract, source extraction, and investigation smoke test; not an accuracy benchmark

factors.label: Model size (number of parameters / depth/width)
factors.reason: To isolate architectural improvements, DeiT and ViT must have comparable capacity.

factors.label: Input image resolution (e.g., 224x224)
factors.reason: Resolution affects patch count and compute; matching ensures fair comparison.

factors.label: External pretraining dataset used before ImageNet fine-tuning
factors.reason: Pre-training data influences representation quality; controlling it removes confounds.

factors.label: Whether distillation token/teacher is employed during training
factors.reason: DeiT's main innovation is distillation; matching this factor tests its effect under same settings.

source.sourceKind: arXiv full text (55,644 characters, tables preserved)

proposals.quote: Our reference vision transformer (86M parameters) achieves top-1 accuracy of 83.1% (single-crop) on ImageNet with no external data.
proposals.explanation: This sentence explicitly states the parameter count of the reference vision transformer, which corresponds to the DeiT‑B model used for the "DeiT– no distillation" result (81.8% top‑1 accuracy). No conflicting information is present in the provided passages.

limitations: Proposals were not accepted. Result-to-passage applicability still requires human review.
